data.name: About_BioDesc
data.value: JustCryptDns is crafted in C# / .NET 8 and WPF to combine low-latency encrypted DNS resolution with lightweight client-side DPI bypass — keeping games responsive without routing all traffic through a slow VPN.

data.name: About_Highlights_Body
data.value: • Full local privacy: no telemetry, no analytics, and zero third-party cloud tracking. • Dual-engine design: Encrypted DNS (DoH / DoT / DoQ / DNSCrypt) + Smart DPI Bypass & Split-Tunnel. • Game-friendly: keeps UDP game traffic direct on your ISP line while unblocking blocked web/storefronts. • Safe OS integration: SHA-256 verified DNS & proxy backups with OS shutdown restore and RunOnce crash recovery.

data.name: About_Arch_Subtitle
data.value: How JustCryptDns processes DNS queries and unblocks DPI-filtered HTTPS traffic locally on Windows.

data.name: About_Arch_Pillar1_Title
data.value: 1. Encrypted Local DNS Proxy (Routing, Filtering & RAM Cache)

data.name: About_Arch_Pillar1_Body
data.value: Windows routes DNS lookups to JustCryptDns's local UDP/TCP listener (127.0.0.1 or automatic 127.0.0.2 if port 53 is occupied). Incoming queries are matched against local blocklists (ads/trackers), served sub-millisecond from an in-memory TTL cache, or routed cleanly to encrypted DoH, DoT, DoQ, or DNSCrypt resolvers to defeat ISP DNS poisoning.

data.name: About_Arch_Pillar2_Body
data.value: Many ISPs use Deep Packet Inspection (SNI inspection or TCP resets) even after DNS succeeds. Instead of forcing a full VPN, JustCryptDns registers a fast loopback PAC script + local SOCKS5/HTTP relay that splits the TLS ClientHello across fragmented records (RecordChunkSplit / OOB Desync). If a site hangs or resets, the 4-stage self-healing loop automatically upgrades strategy and remembers what works per domain.

data.name: About_Arch_Pillar3_Body
data.value: Game UDP traffic stays untouched on your direct network interface for lowest ping, while Gaming Mode applies low-jitter polling and DNS presets. Continuous health scoring monitors resolver latency and switches seamlessly to your secondary failover resolver if an upstream endpoint degrades.

data.name: About_Arch_Pillar4_Title
data.value: 4. Network Safety, Shutdown Hooks & Boot Recovery

data.name: About_Arch_Pillar4_Body
data.value: Before changing any Windows adapter DNS or WinINet proxy setting, JustCryptDns seals the original state to disk with SHA-256 verification and runs a live connectivity probe. When closing or shutting down Windows (OnSessionEnding), original DNS/proxy settings are restored immediately, while HKCU RunOnce (--recover-and-exit) stands guard to heal connectivity automatically after unexpected power loss.
